factories.name: newListCardsStep
factories.description: List one bounded page of a board's or a list's open, closed, or all cards, newest first, optionally only cards due in a time range or with a given due-complete state, continuing with the oldest card ID on the page.

inputSchema.description: ListCardsInput selects one page of cards. Set exactly one of BoardID and ListID. Trello filters by Status; the connector applies the due filters to each page, so a page can hold fewer matching cards than PageSize, even none, while NextBefore is set.

before.description: Before continues a previous list with the same filters from its NextBefore; blank reads the newest cards first.

boardId.description: BoardID lists the cards of this board ID.

dueAfter.description: DueAfter keeps only cards due at or after this instant.

dueBefore.description: DueBefore keeps only cards due strictly before this instant.

hasDueDate.description: HasDueDate keeps only cards with a due date when true and only cards without one when false.

isDueComplete.description: IsDueComplete keeps only cards whose due date is marked complete when true, or not complete when false.

listId.description: ListID lists the cards of this list ID.

pageSize.description: PageSize is the number of cards to read from Trello, 1 to 100; zero requests 50.

status.description: Status selects open, closed (archived), or all cards; blank lists open cards.

factories.name: newGetCardStep
factories.description: Read one card by ID with its list, archive state, due and start dates, labels, members, position, and plain-text description.

cardId.description: CardID is the card's Trello ID, 24 hexadecimal characters.

factories.name: newCreateCardStep
factories.description: Create one card in a list with a name, a plain-text description, a due date, labels, members, and a position. Sync durability and a checkpoint prevent replay after ambiguous responses; 429 and 503 retry.

inputSchema.description: CreateCardInput describes one card in one list.

description.description: Description is the plain-text description, at most 16384 characters; blank sends none.

due.description: Due is when the card is due; nil sends none.

labelIds.description: LabelIDs adds up to 50 labels of the list's board by ID.

listId.description: ListID is the ID of the list that receives the card; the list also decides the card's board.

memberIds.description: MemberIDs adds up to 50 board members to the card by ID.

name.description: Name is the one-line card name, at most 16384 characters.

position.description: Position is top, bottom, or a positive number; blank keeps Trello's default position.

factories.name: newUpdateCardStep
factories.description: Move a card to a list, archive or reopen it, set or clear its due date and due-complete state, and set, add, or remove labels or set members; every change is an absolute value, so a repeated update leaves the same card.

inputSchema.description: UpdateCardInput changes one card. Every set field is an absolute value, so sending the same update twice leaves the same card. Set at least one change; set at most one of LabelIDs and AddLabelIDs or RemoveLabelIDs, and at most one of Due and ShouldClearDue.

addLabelIds.description: AddLabelIDs adds up to 50 label IDs to the card's current labels, read first.

boardId.description: BoardID names the board of ListID when that list is on another board; it requires ListID.

cardId.description: CardID is the card's Trello ID.

due.description: Due sets when the card is due; nil leaves it.

isClosed.description: IsClosed archives the card when true and reopens it when false; nil leaves it.

isDueComplete.description: IsDueComplete marks the due date complete when true and not complete when false; nil leaves it.

labelIds.description: LabelIDs replaces the card's labels with up to 50 label IDs of its board; a pointer to an empty list removes every label, and nil leaves them.

listId.description: ListID moves the card to this list, which is how a Trello card changes status; blank leaves its list.

memberIds.description: MemberIDs replaces the card's members with up to 50 member IDs of its board; a pointer to an empty list removes every member, and nil leaves them.

position.description: Position is top, bottom, or a positive number in the card's list; blank leaves Trello's choice.

removeLabelIds.description: RemoveLabelIDs removes up to 50 label IDs from the card's current labels, read first.

shouldClearDue.description: ShouldClearDue removes the card's due date.

factories.name: newAddCommentStep
factories.description: Add one plain-text comment, authored by the token's member, to a card. Sync durability and a checkpoint prevent replay after ambiguous responses; 429 and 503 retry.

inputSchema.description: AddCommentInput describes one comment on one card.

cardId.description: CardID is the card's Trello ID.

text.description: Text is the plain-text comment, at most 16384 characters; line breaks are kept.
